note: One record per competitor claim. Every row carries a source link and a summary written in our own words. Summaries are UNVERIFIED and must not be presented as fact: a model or a human condensed a competitor's post and may have misstated it. Verdict is MobileCloud's standing for that capability — have / partial / absent.

items.summary: Persistent workspaces that an agent can keep using across runs, announced at Ship 2026 alongside async workers.
Background workers that keep running after the request that started them has returned.
A connector directory so an agent can act on third-party services without holding the underlying credentials itself.
Sessions bound to a device, with proof-of-possession tokens for the CLI described as in progress.
Sandbox startup made several times quicker, aimed at agents that need a fresh isolated environment per step.
A completed ISO/IEC 42001 AI-management certification, an audited governance claim rather than a runtime feature.
Micro virtual machines built to host coding agents, with isolation as the product's whole reason to exist.
One MCP endpoint that gives an agent scoped reach to its compute and a chosen subset of apps.
Container filesystem snapshots that let an agent keep a workspace between invocations.
A gateway that lets a seller charge an agent for a request, settling over the x402/HTTP 402 convention.
Long-running backends on the platform, moving it past the request/response shape of edge functions.
A large connector catalogue aimed at agents that need to reach many services out of the box.
Services and agents that run next to the database with no limit on how long they stay up.
A self-reported large smartphone network doing confidential compute, with agents paying in USDC over x402.
